text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chaired annual meeting of the high council of magistracy.
- Heavy rain in different regions of the country despite summer.
- Tunisia starts preparation for stocking foodstuffs for the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan.
- President Ben Ali offers condolences to his South Korean counterpart Kim Young-Sam after the crash of the Korean airlines flight early on Wednesday with 254 people abroad.
- Airline Tunis Air to buy eight aircraft of type Airbus 320 and one of type A300 to replace part of its fleet.
